title: Scrimp
summary: SCRIMP, verb transitive To contract; to shorten; to make too small or short; to limit or straiten; as, to scrimp the pattern of a coat. SCRIMP, adjective Short; scanty. SCRIMP, noun A pinching miser;

inlines.v: SCRIMP, verb transitive To contract; to shorten; to make too small or short; to limit or straiten; as, to scrimp the pattern of a coat. SCRIMP, adjective Short; scanty. SCRIMP, noun A pinching miser; a niggard; a close fisted person.
